definitions.seed: A seed must be the latest identically qualifying fill at or before start, searched no more than seven days backward; future fills cannot seed the interval.
definitions.floor: OpenSea listing floor is contextual only and is never used as a sale, seed, TWAP input, or substitute for unavailable historical trade data.
definitions.scope: Only Ethereum contract 0x2c889a24af0d0ec6337db8feb589fa6368491146 (Boo Bears) is in scope; no similarly named collections, wrappers or other projects are included.
definitions.metric: Last qualifying paid ETH/WETH secondary-sale unit price is carried forward and time-weighted over the exact half-open 86400-second interval; floor only the final quotient.
definitions.ordering: Fills are ordered by block timestamp, block number, transaction index and log index; the final same-timestamp fill prevails and the final price extends to the exclusive end.
definitions.availability: No qualifying seed or in-window fill was found from the audited public chain data. The typed zero is an availability placeholder required by this uint256 response shape, not a valid sales-price TWAP.
definitions.qualification: A fill requires a successful receipt, marketplace settlement evidence, one Boo Bears ERC721/isolated ERC1155 item, nonzero ETH or WETH payment, and distinct buyer and seller; listings, offers, transfers, mints, gifts, bundles, other tokens and non-ETH/WETH consideration are excluded.
